name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.2.9: retrieve.py was using PEP 604 (`X | Y`) type hints which only work on Python 3.10+; many install.sh venvs end up on Python 3.9. Added `from __future__ import annotations` so all annotation evaluation is deferred to strings — fixes 'TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |' on import. v0.2.8 daemon health line + list/remove cli; v0.2.7 install lock cleanup; v0.2.6 daemon_client.py; v0.2.5 dedup OFF + used self-report; v0.2.0–0.2.4 custom skill registration + UX fixes.
